Entry.JapaneseText: ヴァルハラ町
Entry.EnglishText: Valhalla Town

Entry.JapaneseText: 見つけてくれて サンキュー！
Entry.EnglishText: Oh, you found me! Thank you~!

Entry.JapaneseText: ご褒美よ！
Entry.EnglishText: Here, a reward!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……では、サラバっ！！
Entry.EnglishText: ...And with that... Farewell!

Entry.JapaneseText: この町は かつて貧しい村でした
Entry.EnglishText: This town was once a very poor village.

Entry.JapaneseText: しかし、平原の地底から 「紅の月」が見つかり、 町は潤ったのです
Entry.EnglishText: However, after "Crimson Moon" was discovered deep beneath the plains, this town began to prosper.

Entry.JapaneseText: 「紅の月」は人工マナの 原料になるルミネイト21を 含んだ原石のことです
Entry.EnglishText: "Crimson Moon" is an ore which contains Luminate-21, one of the raw materials for making artificial mana.

Entry.JapaneseText: ここから南西にアルヴァニスタ、 さらに西にユークリッド
Entry.EnglishText: Alvanista lies to the southwest of here, and further west lies Euclid.

Entry.JapaneseText: 世界は広いです。 ……あの地平まで私は行きたい！
Entry.EnglishText: The world is quite vast. ...Bring me that horizon!

Entry.JapaneseText: 虹輪の脅威が去り 人々は幸せな生活に 戻っています
Entry.EnglishText: Now that the threat of the Prism Ring has gone, the people can live their lives happily once more.

Entry.JapaneseText: 虹輪を消してくれたのは いったい、誰なのでしょう
Entry.EnglishText: But who could possibly have gotten rid of that Prism Ring?

Entry.JapaneseText: 誰かはわかりませんが、 虹輪を消してくれた人、 ありがとう！
Entry.EnglishText: Well, I may not know who you are, but to whoever got rid of that Prism Ring: thank you!

Entry.JapaneseText: この声が善意のそのかたに 届くことを切に祈っています
Entry.EnglishText: I pray fervently that my voice may reach that individual of highest virtue.

Entry.JapaneseText: もともとこの街に住んでいたのは 他の街を追い出された貧しい人や 差別を受けた人々でした
Entry.EnglishText: Originally, the people living here were poor people who had been chased out of other towns, or who had faced discrimination.

Entry.JapaneseText: しかし、紅の月が見つかり、 遺民事件と呼ばれるあの出来事が あって、この街は変わりました
Entry.EnglishText: However, with the discovery of Crimson Moon and the "False Inheritance" incident that followed thereafter, this town changed.
Entry.Notes: we're going to need a better name for this

Entry.JapaneseText: 遺民事件とは、 紅の月の採掘に来た人々が、 元の住民を追い出した事件です
Entry.EnglishText: During the "False Inheritance" incident, those who came to mine Crimson Moon drove out the town's original residents.

Entry.JapaneseText: 元いた住民の子孫はこの街には いません。彼らはどこへ 行ってしまったのでしょう
Entry.EnglishText: The descendants of those original residents do not live in this village. One does wonder where they've all gone...

Entry.JapaneseText: 我が祖先がしたこととは言え、 なんとも恥ずかしいことです
Entry.EnglishText: It's a shameful thing, what our ancestors did.

Entry.JapaneseText: おまけにこの事件のことは 長らく街の者にも 秘密にされていました
Entry.EnglishText: Not least because, for quite a long time, the incident was kept secret from even the newer town residents.

Entry.JapaneseText: 悪い魔女の噂を知ってるか？
Entry.EnglishText: Hey, do you know about those "wicked witch" rumors?

Entry.JapaneseText: 知らない？ 知らないことは幸せなことだ
Entry.EnglishText: You don't? Well, ignorance is bliss.

Entry.JapaneseText: 悪い魔女は 竜巻で街を襲い 店先にある食糧を奪う！
Entry.EnglishText: The wicked witch attacks entire towns with tornadoes, and steals the food from in front of shops!

Entry.JapaneseText: なんてセコイ魔女だ。 食うもんくらい 自分で買えっ！
Entry.EnglishText: Awfully petty, that witch! Just buy the things you wanna eat, dammit!

Entry.JapaneseText: あら、あんたたち、仕事！？ 今日はお願いすること 何もないよ？
Entry.EnglishText: Oh my, are you two here for work!? Well, I don't have any requests for you today.

Entry.JapaneseText: ああ、もうすぐお祭りがあるから、 その準備の手伝いを お願いしたいところだね
Entry.EnglishText: Actually, there's a festival soon, so I'd like to request your help with the preparations.

Entry.JapaneseText: いつも世話になってるね。 えっと、イオにメグだったかい
Entry.EnglishText: I owe so much to you two! ...Um, Io and Meg, wasn't it?

Entry.JapaneseText: おや、違うか、 イボにカグ……おや……？
Entry.EnglishText: Oh no, those aren't your names? Then... Ivo and Crag? No...?

Entry.JapaneseText: 虹輪は悪い魔女のせいじゃ なかったらしいが、それが どうした！
Entry.EnglishText: It seems the Prism Ring wasn't the work of the wicked witch, but at this point, who even cares!?

Entry.JapaneseText: それまでにしたイタズラの数々、 私も、誰も許しゃしないからな！
Entry.EnglishText: She's already played so many pranks, anyway! I'll never forgive her! And I guarantee you no one else will, either!

Entry.JapaneseText: 魔女めぇ…… うちの台所からかすめ取った コロッケ１個、返せ！
Entry.EnglishText: That damn witch... Give me back the croquette you swiped from my kitchen, dammit!

Entry.JapaneseText: 壁の落書きを消すために使った 水と塗料の代金を返せ！
Entry.EnglishText: And while you're at it, pay me back for all the water and paint I had to use to clean up your graffiti, too!

Entry.JapaneseText: おほほ…… あっしは金持ち妻ざんすのよ
Entry.EnglishText: Ohoho... I'm the wife of a very wealthy man, I'll have you know.

Entry.JapaneseText: ま、って言うても この街の人はみんな 金持ちざんすけどね……
Entry.EnglishText: Well, not that it merits saying. All the people of this town are quite wealthy, I'll have you know.

Entry.JapaneseText: 税金もないし、治安もいい…… ヴァルハラはよい街ざんす 「紅の月」様々ざんす
Entry.EnglishText: No taxes, a rules-based order... Valhalla's a good town, I'll have you know. All thanks to "Crimson Moon," I'll have you know.

Entry.JapaneseText: え？ 住みたい？ 無理ざんす。 定員いっぱいざんす
Entry.EnglishText: Eh? You'd like to live here? Absolutely not, I'll have you know. No vacancies, I'll have you know.

Entry.JapaneseText: おほほ…… あっしは金持ち妻、今日は ショッピングを楽しむざます
Entry.EnglishText: Ohoho... I say, I'm the wife of a very wealthy man, and today, I'm off to enjoy a little shopping.

Entry.JapaneseText: 最近は買うものが何もないのが 悩みざます。欲しいものは 全部手に入れたざますのよ
Entry.EnglishText: I say, my greatest worry these days is how little there is to buy. I say, I already own everything I've ever wanted.

Entry.JapaneseText: 悩む、悩むざます…… 今日は何を買おうかしら、 ミドリガメ？ 未来設計椅子？
Entry.EnglishText: It's such a worry, I say, such a worry... I wonder, what shall I buy today? A lion cub? A new toilet seat?

Entry.JapaneseText: ……この前、買った ポチョムさんＴシャツは 失敗だったざます……
Entry.EnglishText: ...I say, the Mr. Potem T-shirt I bought before wasn't the best purchase...

Entry.JapaneseText: おほほ……あっしは金持ち妻、 お金なら余るほどあるざます
Entry.EnglishText: Ohoho... I say, I'm the wife of a very wealthy man, and have far more money than I could ever require.

Entry.JapaneseText: このあいだはヴァルハラ平原の 土地を３０万坪ほど乗馬場として 買ったざーますのよ
Entry.EnglishText: I say, just recently, I purchased 250 acres of Valhalla Plains land, simply to ride my *many* horses on~

Entry.JapaneseText: 次はどんな買い物をして ライバル妻様に勝とうかしら
Entry.EnglishText: I wonder what I should buy next? I must outdo that *other* woman, naturally...

Entry.JapaneseText: ライバル妻様はミッドガルズ跡を ３０億ガルドで買ったそうざます。 お金の無駄遣いざますのにね～
Entry.EnglishText: I say, that *other* woman bought the Midgard Ruins for 3,000,000,000 Gald. I say, isn't that just *such* a waste of money~?

Entry.JapaneseText: ブライトローズって魔女が 子どもをさらっていくって 本当かしら
Entry.EnglishText: I heard a witch by the name of "Bright Rose" has been kidnapping children. I wonder if it's true.

Entry.JapaneseText: うちの子も 気をつけなきゃ。 クワラバくわばら
Entry.EnglishText: My son will need to be careful, too. Noggin wood...

Entry.JapaneseText: 魔女は子どもをさらって 食べるのかしら？ マサカリまさか！
Entry.EnglishText: So if a witch is kidnapping children, then does she eat them? But... That's just an old why's tale, surely!

Entry.JapaneseText: 使用人としてこき使うとか？ うちの子にそんなこと させられない！
Entry.EnglishText: Maybe she makes them slave away as her servants? Well, I won't let her do that with *my* kids!

Entry.JapaneseText: あらあら、<Dio>くんに、 <Mel>ちゃんね、感心だわ、 その歳でお仕事なんて
Entry.EnglishText: Oh my, it's <Dio> and <Mel>! I'm so proud of you. Doing all this work, at your age!

Entry.JapaneseText: うちの息子にも爪のアカ、 煎じて飲ませたいくらい
Entry.EnglishText: Meanwhile, my son's such a handful. Maybe I'll try feeding him nothing but vegetables, just until he stops misbehaving so much...

Entry.JapaneseText: そう言えば、うちの屋根、 壊れてたけど、あれ直すの お願いできないかしら？
Entry.EnglishText: Speaking of, a part of my roof is broken. I wouldn't be able to ask you two to fix it, would I?

Entry.JapaneseText: あらあら、それはあなたたちに お願いするには、ちょっと 危険すぎるかしらね
Entry.EnglishText: But oh dear, perhaps that's a little too dangerous of a job to ask of the two of you!

Entry.JapaneseText: うちの子が新しいかめにん人形を 買ってくれって聞かないの！
Entry.EnglishText: I swear, if that child of mine asks me to buy him a new Turtlez doll one more time...!

Entry.JapaneseText: ブライトローズが来て、 さらわれるわよって脅しても 全然、ダメなのよね……
Entry.EnglishText: I told him if he keeps acting like this, Bright Rose will come and take him away, but he just ignored me...

Entry.JapaneseText: 悪いことしたら、悪い魔女が さらいに来るわよって、 言ってもあんまり効果ないのよね
Entry.EnglishText: "If you're a bad kid, a big bad witch will come and take you away!" That's what I told him, but he's hardly changed at all.

Entry.JapaneseText: むしろ、連れてってほしいって 言うんだもの、らちがあかないわ
Entry.EnglishText: At this point, I almost wish she would take him away. He just doesn't listen at all!

Entry.JapaneseText: うちのお母さん うざい……
Entry.EnglishText: My mom's so annoying...

Entry.JapaneseText: 心配するのはわかるけど いつでもどこでも ついてくるのやめてほしいな……
Entry.EnglishText: I know she worries about me, but she doesn't need to follow me anywhere and everywhere...

Entry.JapaneseText: この前なんて 友達とかくれんぼしてる とこまでついてきて……
Entry.EnglishText: A while ago, I was playing hide- and-seek with my friends, and she followed me the whole time...

Entry.JapaneseText: お母さんのせいで あっさり見つかって…… もうやだ……
Entry.EnglishText: They found me right away, and all because of her... I'm sick of it...

Entry.JapaneseText: あ、<Dio>と<Mel>！ いいなぁ、いろんなところで いろんなお仕事できて……
Entry.EnglishText: Oh, it's <Dio> and <Mel>! It sounds so nice, getting to do so many different jobs in so many different places.

Entry.JapaneseText: ボクも連れてってよ…… ってムリかぁ。 うちのお母さんが許さないもん
Entry.EnglishText: Honestly, I want to come with you... But I guess I can't, huh? My mom would never let me, after all.

Entry.JapaneseText: なりきり士の仕事って おもしろい？
Entry.EnglishText: Been enjoying your roleplayer jobs?

Entry.JapaneseText: ボクもできるかなぁ…… でも働くって大変そう
Entry.EnglishText: I wonder if I can be one, too... But working sounds like it's pretty tough, sometimes.

Entry.JapaneseText: 今流行りのかめにん人形、 欲しいんだけど、 お母さんが買わないって
Entry.EnglishText: Turtlez dolls are pretty popular now. I want one, too, but my mom said no.

Entry.JapaneseText: ケチ……！
Entry.EnglishText: Stingy...!

Entry.JapaneseText: かめにん人形がほしいって だけじゃないんだ
Entry.EnglishText: Like, come on, all I asked for was a Turtlez doll.

Entry.JapaneseText: ボクたちが好きなものを お母さんにも理解して ほしいってだけ……
Entry.EnglishText: I just wish moms could try to understand what their kids are into, you know...?

Entry.JapaneseText: 南のミッドガルズが滅びたのは もうずっと前のことだ
Entry.EnglishText: It's been a long time now, since Midgard, to the south, was destroyed.

Entry.JapaneseText: あれほどにも栄えた国が 簡単に滅びる…… まさに諸行無常だな
Entry.EnglishText: To think, a flourishing country like that can get wiped out so easily... Must be what they mean by "All is vanity," huh?

Entry.JapaneseText: 永遠に栄えるものなど どこにもない。そんなことは 誰もが知っている
Entry.EnglishText: No matter how successful you are, it won't last forever. Everyone knows that.

Entry.JapaneseText: しかし、愚かにも その滅びが自分の生きている間に 来ると、誰も想像だにしていない
Entry.EnglishText: However, the fools we are, none of us even dare to imagine that great fall might come in our own lifetimes.

Entry.JapaneseText: ここだけの話…… 実は「紅の月」の鉱床は 尽きかけているという
Entry.EnglishText: Just between you and me... I hear those "Crimson Moon" deposits have just about dried up, now.

Entry.JapaneseText: 「紅の月」が採れなくなったら この街はおしまいだ
Entry.EnglishText: Once the "Crimson Moon" runs out, this town is finished.

Entry.JapaneseText: 街の人間たちは 「紅の月」が永遠に 採れると勘違いしてる
Entry.EnglishText: All the townspeople have it in mind that their "Crimson Moon" money will just keep flowing, forever.

Entry.JapaneseText: 危機感がなさすぎだ。 今にみんな 痛い目を見るぞ
Entry.EnglishText: They're too calm. Not anxious enough. And they're gonna be in for a world of hurt, and soon.

Entry.JapaneseText: 例え、この街の栄えを支える 「紅の月」の鉱床が枯れても、 私はここにとどまるのだろうな
Entry.EnglishText: But me? I'll probably stick around here even after the "Crimson Moon" has dried up, and the town's prosperity has gone with it.

Entry.JapaneseText: 例え、滅びが来るのだとしても 私はそれに振り回され、騒いだり、 焦ったりするのはゴメンだ
Entry.EnglishText: 'Cause, me? I can't be bothered with all the running around, the panicking, and the *hysteria*, not even once it's all ending.

Entry.JapaneseText: 私はすべてをなるがままに 身を委ねるだけだ
Entry.EnglishText: Whatever the future holds, I'll let it decide my fate for me.

Entry.JapaneseText: それが強大な力であろうと、 何者かに翻弄されるなど、 みっともないことこのうえない
Entry.EnglishText: No matter who or how powerful they are, there's nothing more shameful than being reduced to someone's plaything.

Entry.JapaneseText: 今、私のいちばんのお気に入りは ねこにん人形だよ～
Entry.EnglishText: My favorite right now is my Katz doll~

Entry.JapaneseText: 悪い魔女に持ってかれないように お父ちゃんの金庫に しまってあるの～
Entry.EnglishText: Dad put it in his safe, so the wicked witch can't take it away~

Entry.JapaneseText: オリジン人形と合体できる きゅーきょくの ねこにん人形だよ～
Entry.EnglishText: It's the all-time-mutt Katz doll~ It can fuse with the Origin doll, too~

Entry.JapaneseText: 大事に大事にしてるんだよ～。 でも、金庫の中だから 合体させられないの～
Entry.EnglishText: It's my treasure~ But it can't fuse with other dolls right now, 'cause it's in a safe~

Entry.JapaneseText: 新しくかめにん人形が 発売されたんだって！
Entry.EnglishText: They started selling a new Turtlez doll!

Entry.JapaneseText: 欲しいなぁ…… でも５００ガルドもするんだ、 高いなぁ……
Entry.EnglishText: I want it... But it's a whole 500 Gald... That's so expensive...

Entry.JapaneseText: あっ、あじくん人形も もうすぐ発売するんだよ！
Entry.EnglishText: Oh, and they'll start selling an Alz doll soon, too!

Entry.JapaneseText: 知ってる？ あじくんってのは、 『ありじごくにん』のことだよ？
Entry.EnglishText: Oh, you don't know Alz? "Alz" just means "Antlionz"!

Entry.JapaneseText: 友達はみんな、 キューティーちゃん人形の おままごとに夢中なの
Entry.EnglishText: All of my friends are always playing house with their Hello Cutie dolls.

Entry.JapaneseText: でも、私の今のマイブームは、 たるろう人形なの！
Entry.EnglishText: But my fixation right now is my Tarlow doll!

Entry.JapaneseText: たるろう人形すごいの！ 関節が全部、稼動するのよ！
Entry.EnglishText: My Tarlow doll is amazing! All of its joints can move!

Entry.JapaneseText: 私の夢は、 世界のどこかに本当にいる 『たるろう』に会うことなの！
Entry.EnglishText: My dream is to meet the real Tarlow someday! I know he's out there somewhere!

Entry.JapaneseText: 今のこの世界があるのは 時空戦士様のおかげさね
Entry.EnglishText: Our world exists as it does today thanks to the Great Heroes of Time.

Entry.JapaneseText: あんたも時空戦士様に 感謝せにゃいかんよ
Entry.EnglishText: You, too, must offer your thanks to the Great Heroes of Time.

Entry.JapaneseText: 時空戦士様は世界を 滅ぼそうとしたダオスを 倒してくださった方々だ
Entry.EnglishText: The Great Heroes of Time are the ones who saved us by defeating Dhaos when he threatened to destroy our world.

Entry.JapaneseText: 感謝しても しすぎるってことはないぞ
Entry.EnglishText: However deep one's gratitude for them, it can never be too much.

Entry.JapaneseText: 今日もお仕事かい？ いつも感心だね
Entry.EnglishText: Oh, you're working today, too? I'm always very thankful for you two, you know.

Entry.JapaneseText: でも、あんまり ムリするんじゃないよ
Entry.EnglishText: But do take care not to push yourselves too hard.

Entry.JapaneseText: あんたたちのお仕事…… なり、きり、士っていうのかい？ それは一体、どんな仕事だい？
Entry.EnglishText: Your work was... Role...play...ers? That's what you called yourselves, wasn't it? But whatever sort of jobs do you do?

Entry.JapaneseText: いろんなことやって感心だけど まだ若いんだ、急いて何か やろうとする必要はないんだよ？
Entry.EnglishText: You've done a lot, and I'm grateful... But you're young. You don't need to be in such a rush to do everything.

Entry.JapaneseText: 時空戦士に会ったとね！？ これまたスゴイことだよ！
Entry.EnglishText: What!? You met the Heroes of Time!? That's incredible!

Entry.JapaneseText: <Cless>様のファイナルスーパー アタックは見たかね？ <Mint>様 の背中の羽根は何枚あったかね？
Entry.EnglishText: Did you see Master <Cless>'s Final Super Attack? How many wings did Lady <Mint> have?

Entry.JapaneseText: 時空戦士たちはみな、 すごい力を持っていたと言うね
Entry.EnglishText: It's said that the Heroes of Time all wielded incredible power.

Entry.JapaneseText: <Klarth>様は精霊様を使って、 海を真っ二つに割ったってね
Entry.EnglishText: Master <Klarth> made use of the Great Spirits to part the Euclid Sea.

Entry.JapaneseText: <Arche>様の魔術は シルヴァラントに大きな クレーター跡を残したんだって
Entry.EnglishText: Lady <Arche>'s magical artes left a huge crater on Sylvarant.

Entry.JapaneseText: <Suzu>様は１００人分身で 敵ばかりか味方も 翻弄されたとのことだよ
Entry.EnglishText: Lady <Suzu>'s 100-Clone Duplication overwhelmed both friend and foe alike. ...Or so it is said.

Entry.JapaneseText: <Chester>様？ <Chester>様は……ええっと……
Entry.EnglishText: Master <Chester>? Umm... Master <Chester>...

Entry.JapaneseText: 街を出たら 魔物に襲われちまった
Entry.EnglishText: I left town...and got attacked by monsters.

Entry.JapaneseText: ったく、魔物さえ いなければ この世界は平和なのによ
Entry.EnglishText: Dammit. If not for all those monsters, the world'd be at peace.

Entry.JapaneseText: ま、街にいれば 安心だけどな
Entry.EnglishText: Well, all's safe if you don't leave town, though.

Entry.JapaneseText: あいつら、人の気配を怖がって 街には入ってこないからな
Entry.EnglishText: The damn things are scared to be 'round too many people, so they won't come into town.

Entry.JapaneseText: おまえたちか、この街で 噂になってる仕事人、 <Dio>と<Mel>ってのは
Entry.EnglishText: Oh, hey, you're those two "pros" everyone's talkin' about 'round town, right? <Dio> and <Mel>, wasn't it?

Entry.JapaneseText: 思ってたより、若いんだな。 もっと精悍な青年たちかと 思ってたぜ
Entry.EnglishText: You're a lot younger than I thought. Figured you'd be a couple of real tough-lookin' young men.

Entry.JapaneseText: そんな細い腕で、 釘が打てるか？ 鋸を引くことできるのか？
Entry.EnglishText: How do you drive a nail with those spindly arms? Can you even use a handsaw?

Entry.JapaneseText: ……むむ、その瞳の輝き、 本物だ！ なかなかできそうだな……
Entry.EnglishText: ...Oh, man. That twinkle in your eyes is the real deal! So you are pretty capable, huh...

Entry.JapaneseText: この街は福利が行き届き、 インフラストラクチャーも 整備されてる。だが……
Entry.EnglishText: There's good public welfare in this town, and the infrastructure's all well-maintained, but...

Entry.JapaneseText: ……刺激がねぇ！ 俺が欲しいのは刺激だ！ こんなだるい空気じゃねぇのさ
Entry.EnglishText: ...nothin' ever happens! I want some excitement, dammit! This place's whole vibe is just too damn *slow*.

Entry.JapaneseText: 街の外は街中とは違い、 一転、魔界さ。 本当の魔界って意味じゃなくな
Entry.EnglishText: Outside the village is pretty much the total opposite. It's all Daemonium out there. I mean, not literally, but...

Entry.JapaneseText: しかし、そこでこそ、 本当に生きてるって 実感があるのよっ！
Entry.EnglishText: But if you wanna *really* feel alive, out there's where you gotta go!

Entry.JapaneseText: ファイアーボーール！！
Entry.EnglishText: FIREBALL!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……なんてな。 魔術ごっこだよ
Entry.EnglishText: ...or something. I'm playing "Wizard." Like, pretending to be one.

Entry.JapaneseText: あーあ、人間も 魔術使えたらなー
Entry.EnglishText: Haaah... Man, I wish humans could use magical artes, too...

Entry.JapaneseText: その昔 人間も魔術が使えた時期が あったんだって
Entry.EnglishText: I think humans used to be able to use magic, though. Like, a really long time ago.

Entry.JapaneseText: なんてったっけ…… でもなんで なくなったのかな？
Entry.EnglishText: I can't really remember the details... Uhh... But anyway, why can't we use it now?

Entry.JapaneseText: なぁなぁ、魔術ごっこしようぜ ボクが魔術師で、 キミたちが魔物ね
Entry.EnglishText: Hey, let's play "Wizard" together. I'll be the wizard, and you be monsters.
... ... ...Not happy with that, huh?

Entry.JapaneseText: ボクもエルフだったら、 魔術が使えるのに……
Entry.EnglishText: Man, if I could just be an elf, then I could use magic, too...

Entry.JapaneseText: カッコイイだろ？ 手から ぼーって火が出たり、 水が出たりすんだぜ？
Entry.EnglishText: That'd be cool, right? I could shoot fire and water and stuff right out of my hands!

Entry.JapaneseText: 心天烈空懺光 戦風滅裁震伐活殺撃！！！！
Entry.EnglishText: Soul of Heaven Sky-Split Light of Penitence Battle Wind Sundering Slice Quaking Strike Life-or-Death Attack!!

Entry.JapaneseText: ………… ほら、倒れろって。 剣士ごっこしてんだから
Entry.EnglishText: ... Hey. Fall down or something. We're playing "Swordsman."

Entry.JapaneseText: 魔術師なんて古いね、 これからの時代、 “剣士”がナウいんだよ
Entry.EnglishText: Wizards are old news. These days, swordsmen are hip and happening.

Entry.JapaneseText: オレが剣士、キミたちが魔物だから……
Entry.EnglishText: So, I'll be the swordman, and you'll be the monsters...
... ... ...Not happy with that, huh?

Entry.JapaneseText: 世界中が霧に閉ざされて、 大変大変！
Entry.EnglishText: The whole world's enshrouded in mist! Oh no! This is *terrible*!

Entry.JapaneseText: なんでもあの霧を吸うと 大変なことになるらしいぞ
どう大変なのかは 知らないけど
Entry.EnglishText: What *kind* of disaster? Well, uh... I'm not really sure, to be honest.

Entry.JapaneseText: とにかく、こんな状態じゃ 他の街には行けやしない
Entry.EnglishText: With things as they are, we can't go to from here to any of the other towns.

Entry.JapaneseText: 霧の中で迷子になって、 海に落ちたら、大変じゃないか！
Entry.EnglishText: You'll get lost in the mist, and fall into the sea! It'll be *terrible*!

Entry.JapaneseText: ああ、よかったよかった、 霧が晴れてよかった！
Entry.EnglishText: Oh, thank goodness, the mist is gone!

Entry.JapaneseText: 残念なことに、あの霧に やられて死んだ人が けっこういるみたいだけど
Entry.EnglishText: But regrettably, it does look like a lot of people got killed by that mist.

Entry.JapaneseText: 命あってのものだね、 自分だけでも瘴気に やられなくてよしとしよう
Entry.EnglishText: Well, most important's that we're still alive. Just be happy the mist didn't get to us, eh?

Entry.JapaneseText: とにかく……みんな、 静かに眠っとくれよ。 南無南無……
Entry.EnglishText: And, I guess... I pray that all the dead are able to rest in peace. Amen.

Entry.JapaneseText: 大変だ、大変だ！ 紅の月を盗賊団が 狙ってるんだって
Entry.EnglishText: Oh no! It's terrible! A group of thieves are coming for our Crimson Moon!

Entry.JapaneseText: その名も「漆黒の翼」！ うちらも騎士団みたいな 自衛組織を作るべきだな
Entry.EnglishText: And they call themselves "The Dark Wings"! We'll need to make ourselves a law enforcement force, like the Knights...

Entry.JapaneseText: 漆黒の翼ってのは、 その昔はたった３人の 組織だったらしいよ
Entry.EnglishText: It seems the Dark Wings used to be a small organization of just three people.

Entry.JapaneseText: それが今や１００人規模の 大所帯だ。まともにやって、 太刀打ちできるかな……
Entry.EnglishText: But they're pretty big, now, with almost 100 people. Can we even hope to fight so many at once...?

Entry.JapaneseText: ぼく、前にあの毒の霧の中に 入っちゃったんだ
Entry.EnglishText: I went into the poison mist before.

Entry.JapaneseText: そしたら、おたまを持った女の子 が、大きな斧持ったぶらぁあ！ とかって叫ぶ男の人と戦ってたよ
Entry.EnglishText: And then I saw a girl with a ladle battle a man with a huge axe, screaming, like, "RAAAAAH!"

Entry.JapaneseText: 霧の中でボクが見たのは 幻覚だったんだって
Entry.EnglishText: They said the stuff I saw in the mist was a hallucination.

Entry.JapaneseText: 死なずにすんだうえに、 面白いものが見られて、 よかったよぅ♪
Entry.EnglishText: I didn't die, and I got to see some really interesting things, too. So I'm happy~ ♪

Entry.JapaneseText: あの毒の霧、瘴気って 言うらしいね～、 魔界の空気なんだって
Entry.EnglishText: Apparently, they call that poison mist "miasma"~ In Daemonium, it's like air.

Entry.JapaneseText: 前に瘴気吸ったけど、 すごい変な味だったよ
Entry.EnglishText: I breathed in some miasma before, and it tasted super funny.

Entry.JapaneseText: 魔界の人、 あんなの吸ってるんだ、 味オンチなんだね～
Entry.EnglishText: I can't believe they breathe that stuff! I guess those people in Daemonium just have no scents of taste~

Entry.JapaneseText: 瘴気を吸っちゃったせいで、 なんか“こーいしょー”って のが残ってるんだ
Entry.EnglishText: Because I breathed in that miasma, I've got some stuff they call "after effex."

Entry.JapaneseText: 時々、変な幻を見るんだ、 ネズミが結婚式の列を作って、 歩いてるのとか……
Entry.EnglishText: Once in a while, I see weird illusions—stuff like mice lining up for a marriage procession...

Entry.JapaneseText: 魔界のこと、もっと知りたいなぁ、 でも、あまり研究が 進んでないみたいだよ
Entry.EnglishText: I kinda wanna know more about Daemonium. But no one's making much progress researching it...

Entry.JapaneseText: みんな怖いから避けてるんだって。 興味のある人は魔界に 行ったきり帰ってこないらしいし
Entry.EnglishText: They're avoiding 'cause "it's scary." And I heard the people who are curious try to go there and then never come back.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……魔界のこと、 もっと知りたい……
Entry.EnglishText: ...I wanna know more about Daemonium...

Entry.JapaneseText: よし！ ぼくも魔界へ行ってみる！ コワくなんてないやい！
Entry.EnglishText: Alright! I'm gonna try going to Daemonium! I'm not scared at all!

Entry.JapaneseText: 昔、この街は汚くて、 ボロボロだったんだって
Entry.EnglishText: They say that long ago, this town was filthy, and just in an awful state all around.

Entry.JapaneseText: 信じらんないわね
Entry.EnglishText: Hard to believe, isn't it?

Entry.JapaneseText: 私、絶対、汚い町に 住むなんてイヤだなぁ
Entry.EnglishText: I'd absolutely hate to live in a dirty town, you know?

Entry.JapaneseText: でも、開拓魂を抱いた たくましい夢溢れる 住民に溢れてたんだってね
Entry.EnglishText: But it was full of brave dreamers, you know, who were themselves full of pioneer spirit.

Entry.JapaneseText: 確かに昔はこの街ボロボロだった らしいけど、その頃より前の記録 が残ってないらしいのよね～
Entry.EnglishText: It certainly seems like this town was in an awful state back then, but there aren't any records going back further than that.

Entry.JapaneseText: この街って一体、いつ、 どうやってできたのかな？ 誰も知らないのよね……
Entry.EnglishText: How, when, and why in the world was this town established? No one knows, I suppose...

Entry.JapaneseText: 匂うわ、 これは絶対なんかあるわね、 空白のヴァルハラ前史時代に
Entry.EnglishText: I can just *smell* it. There's definitely something big hiding there—in that blank space in Valhalla's history.

Entry.JapaneseText: 陰謀の匂い？ この街にとって、具合の 悪いことがあったのかしら？
Entry.EnglishText: The smell of conspiracy, perhaps? Was there something just too awful for the town to keep records of, back then?

Entry.JapaneseText: この街の過去を 調べていくと必ず ぶち当たる壁があるの
Entry.EnglishText: When you look into this town's past, you'll always run into a brick wall at a certain point.

Entry.JapaneseText: それが５０年前のダオス戦役後の シグルドの占拠事件なのよ
Entry.EnglishText: And that brick wall's about fifty years ago... The incident when Sigurd occupied the town, after Dhaos's War.

Entry.JapaneseText: シグルド占拠事件を境に この街の歴史の記録が ごっそりないのよね
Entry.EnglishText: That occupation incident's like a dividing line between the town history we know and the older history we don't.

Entry.JapaneseText: それより前の世界の記録は たくさんあるんだけど。 なんでかしら……匂うわ……
Entry.EnglishText: But there's plenty of *world* history going back further than that. So what's that about, hmm? It just smells so...fishy...

Entry.JapaneseText: この街はなんとか 瘴気に侵されずに済んでるが、 他の街はどうなったろう
Entry.EnglishText: Somehow or other, this town's been spared from the miasma, but how are other towns doing?

Entry.JapaneseText: オリーブヴィレッジに住む 弟夫婦のことが心配だ
Entry.EnglishText: I'm worried for my brother and his wife, down in Olive Village.

Entry.JapaneseText: いや……過剰な期待は 抱かないようにしておこう……
Entry.EnglishText: Well... I guess I shouldn't be too optimistic, really...

Entry.JapaneseText: 最悪の事態は、覚悟しているよ。 今やそういう状況だしね
Entry.EnglishText: I'm prepared for the worst. Under the circumstances, I kind of have to be, y'know?

Entry.JapaneseText: 世界中の瘴気が晴れたみたいで 助かったよ……
Entry.EnglishText: Looks like all the miasma's finally cleared up... That's a relief...

Entry.JapaneseText: オリーブヴィレッジに住んでいる 弟夫婦からも便りがあって、 向こうも無事だったって
Entry.EnglishText: And I've heard from my brother and his wife in Olive Village, too. They're safe and sound there, too.

Entry.JapaneseText: 本当に無事でよかった…… 今はただそればかり……
Entry.EnglishText: I'm so glad they're safe... That's all I care about, really...

Entry.JapaneseText: 天が与えてくれた その幸運に感謝するよ
Entry.EnglishText: The heavens have blessed us with this good fortune, and I'm grateful for that.

Entry.JapaneseText: ダオス戦役に、瘴気…… この時代は災厄続きだ
Entry.EnglishText: First Dhaos's War, and now the miasma... Our era's just one disaster after another.

Entry.JapaneseText: こんな時代に生まれて 不幸と思うか、それでも 生き延びて幸せと思うか……
Entry.EnglishText: I'm not sure if I should curse my fate for being born now, of all times, or just be grateful I'm still alive...

Entry.JapaneseText: 考え方次第だよね
Entry.EnglishText: I guess that's all a matter of perspective, really.

Entry.JapaneseText: ダオス戦役、瘴気と災厄が 続いたから、きっと僕の後の 半生は平和に違いないよ
Entry.EnglishText: Dhaos's War, the miasma... Well, I've already lived through two disasters, so I'm sure the latter half my life will be peaceful.

Entry.JapaneseText: そう考えると 明日から楽しく生きられそうだ
Entry.EnglishText: When I look at it that way, I feel like I can just wake up tomorrow and enjoy my life.

Entry.JapaneseText: もうダメ、もうダメだわ！ わたしたち！
Entry.EnglishText: We're done for! We're finished!

Entry.JapaneseText: このまま、あの毒気に 包まれて死んでしまうのよ！
Entry.EnglishText: We'll get engulfed in that toxic gas and then we're dead! We're all dead!

Entry.JapaneseText: もう最期だわ、もう最期なの、 この世界は！
Entry.EnglishText: This is the end! This is it for our world! It's all over!

Entry.JapaneseText: すべてがすべてあの毒気の海に 沈んで、何もかも命を 落としてしまうの！
Entry.EnglishText: Everything, everywhere's awash in that toxic gas, now! There's nothing left alive out there! Nothing!

Entry.JapaneseText: 一時期はこの世は全部 終わっちゃうかと 諦めてたけど……
Entry.EnglishText: I'd given up... I really thought it was the end of the world... The end of everything...

Entry.JapaneseText: 一抹の希望を捨てずに 生きていてよかったわ
Entry.EnglishText: But I guess I should be happy for that last little shred of hope I'd held onto, that kept me alive.

Entry.JapaneseText: 街全体が瘴気に覆われた時は 本当にダメかと思ったの
Entry.EnglishText: When the miasma covered our whole town, I thought it was over.

Entry.JapaneseText: でも、街のみんなで地下室に 逃げ込んで、なんとか 生き延びたのよ
Entry.EnglishText: But everyone in town huddled together underground, and, somehow, we survived.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……逃げ遅れて、 亡くなった方もいるけどね……
Entry.EnglishText: ...Some people were too late, though, and those people died...

Entry.JapaneseText: 今度はどこかで、 大規模な戦争でも あるんじゃないかしら……
Entry.EnglishText: Maybe there'll be another huge war soon, somewhere or other...

Entry.JapaneseText: でも備えあれば憂いなし、 こう悪いことばかりだと、 いろいろ心構えができるものね
Entry.EnglishText: But if you're prepared, you can handle anything—and with all that's happened already, I think I am prepared, mentally.

Entry.JapaneseText: 瘴気で世界が包まれた時は すごく取り乱しちゃったけど、 次はもっと落ち着いて行動するわ
Entry.EnglishText: When the world was engulfed by miasma, I was crazy panicked, but whatever's next, I'll deal with it much more calmly.

Entry.JapaneseText: 人は学んで、 進歩する生物なのよ～
Entry.EnglishText: As humans, we learn a little, and grow a little, every day~

Entry.JapaneseText: なるほど……世界最期の日、か。 こんな形でそれが訪れるとはな
Entry.EnglishText: Ah, I see... So these are the final days of this world, are they? To think, this is how it all ends...

Entry.JapaneseText: それも私が生きている間に…… ま、それもよかろう、 滅びるなら滅びるがいい
Entry.EnglishText: ...and while I still live, too. Well, that's just as well. If the world is to be destroyed, let it be destroyed.

Entry.JapaneseText: 老い先短い身の上だ、 世界が滅びようと どうしようと構わんさ
Entry.EnglishText: My body's not got much time left, anyway, so whatever happens to this world, it doesn't matter much to me.

Entry.JapaneseText: １、２か月ほど死ぬのが 早まったってだけだからな
Entry.EnglishText: At most, it'll just mean I die a month or two sooner.

Entry.JapaneseText: なんだ……あっさりと 世界最期の日は 終わってしもうたな
Entry.EnglishText: ...Huh... And the world's "final days" are over, just like that.

Entry.JapaneseText: ま、それはそれでまた一興…… もう少し生きるのを 楽しむとするか……
Entry.EnglishText: Well, that was entertaining, if nothing else... And now I get to live a little longer... I might as well enjoy it...

Entry.JapaneseText: 別に死にたいというわけでは ないのだが、生きたいという わけでもない
Entry.EnglishText: I don't particularly want to die, but I don't want to live, either.

Entry.JapaneseText: どうせ、今だって どっちつかずな状態なのだ。 それが余生というもんだよ
Entry.EnglishText: As I am right now, I don't have a preference either way. That's how it is, when you've lived as long as I have.

Entry.JapaneseText: また今日も生き延びてしもうたわ。 毎朝、朝日を見るたびに、 ほとほとと涙が落ちるようになった
Entry.EnglishText: I've survived today, as I did yesterday. Every morning, as I see the sun rise, the tears start falling, all on their own.

Entry.JapaneseText: 何じゃろうな、この涙は…… 喜びか、悲しみか、 それとも寂しさか
Entry.EnglishText: What are those tears about...? Happiness? Sadness? ...Loneliness?

Entry.JapaneseText: やりたいことも 全部、やり終えたし、 語らう友も、もうおらぬ
Entry.EnglishText: I've already finished doing all the things I wanted to do, and my closest friends are long gone, now.

Entry.JapaneseText: ほんに惰性とはこういうことを 言うのやもしれんな
Entry.EnglishText: I just keep living out of habit, I guess. That's all there really is to it, anymore.

Entry.JapaneseText: ヴァルハラは 我々が作った街…… そして……やつらに……
Entry.EnglishText: Valhalla's the town we built... And these bastards... They...

Entry.JapaneseText: うぅっ……いや…… もはや昔のこと、 言うまいよ
Entry.EnglishText: Uuugh... No... There's no sense in dredging up the past. Not now. Not anymore.

Entry.JapaneseText: 済んだこと、終わったことを 当事者が今更言うても、 恨み言にしかならん
Entry.EnglishText: What's done is done. I was there, but it was a long time ago. To talk about it now... I'd just be giving voice to a grudge.

Entry.JapaneseText: だから、何も言わん。 ……ワシらにも非があるて
Entry.EnglishText: So I won't say a word. ...We weren't without fault, either.

Entry.JapaneseText: 私が、この街を 追い出されたのは まだ１０歳の頃だったか
Entry.EnglishText: When I was run out of this town, I was just ten years old.

Entry.JapaneseText: あれから５０年、 もはやあの頃のことを 知る者は、おらん
Entry.EnglishText: It's been fifty years. No one remembers what happened back then. Not anymore.

Entry.JapaneseText: 追い出された者の 大半は死んでしもうた
Entry.EnglishText: Most of the people who were run out of this town died not long after.

Entry.JapaneseText: 私たちを追い出した連中は この街を去ってしまった
Entry.EnglishText: The ones who drove us out have all left.

Entry.JapaneseText: あの昔の出来事は 誰も語る者がおらん
Entry.EnglishText: There's no one left to pass down the story of all that happened, back then.

Entry.JapaneseText: ヴァルハラは、すっかり 変わってしもうた……みな、 腹を空かして、飢えとったのに
Entry.EnglishText: Valhalla's changed, completely... Back then, everyone was hungry...starving...

Entry.JapaneseText: 今、この街の不満ごとと言えば、 贅沢なものばかりじゃ
Entry.EnglishText: If you ask the townspeople what they're unsatisfied with now... It's all frivolous things.

Entry.JapaneseText: 昔話をしても、栓のない話じゃな。 昔は昔、今は今じゃ。 みな、今の流儀で生きるがよい
Entry.EnglishText: But once you start talking about the past, you'll never finish. That was then. This is now. People living how they do now is fine.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……あれこれ言うてしまうのは 年寄りのサガじゃ、許せ
Entry.EnglishText: ...Sorry. We old folks always do ramble on a little.

Entry.JapaneseText: ダオス戦役には この街も無縁で助かったけど、 今度は逃れられないの？
Entry.EnglishText: This town survived Dhaos's War on account of not gettin' involved, but... Is there just no escapin' this one?

Entry.JapaneseText: 私死んじゃうのかしら…… 死ぬの、ヤー！
Entry.EnglishText: Am I gonna die...? I don't wanna die!

Entry.JapaneseText: ね、何が起きてるの？ 何が起きてるかわかんないまま、 死ぬのなんてヤーよ！
Entry.EnglishText: Hey, what's even goin' on? I don't wanna die without even knowin' what's happenin'!

Entry.JapaneseText: わかったからいいって 問題でもないけど……
Entry.EnglishText: I mean, even if I did know, I'm still not gonna be okay with dyin', but...

Entry.JapaneseText: この街の東の方に 昔、ダオスの城っていうのが あったみたいね
Entry.EnglishText: Seems there used to be a place called Dhaos's Castle to the east of this town, a long time ago.

Entry.JapaneseText: 南の方には ミッドガルズって街が あったんだって
Entry.EnglishText: And I heard there was a town called Midgard to the south.

Entry.JapaneseText: ダオス城跡もミッドガルズ跡も 行ったことあんだけど、 何もないんだよね
Entry.EnglishText: I've been to both ruins, the Dhaos Castle ones and the Midgard ones, but there's not a lot there.

Entry.JapaneseText: つまんないとこよ、 行って損したって感じ
Entry.EnglishText: It's pretty borin', actually. Feels like I wasted my time.

Entry.JapaneseText: 温かくなったら、 北の方へ旅に出ようかと思うの
Entry.EnglishText: Once I've warmed up, I think I'll take off to the north.

Entry.JapaneseText: 冬は虫になって過ごして、 夏になると植物になる とても不思議な生物を探すのよ！
Entry.EnglishText: I'm lookin' for this super mysterious creature that turns into a bug in winter, then into a plant in summer!

Entry.JapaneseText: その辺りには聖なる乙女が 大好きなツノが生えた エロい馬もいるらしいわ！
Entry.EnglishText: And there's supposed to be this super- sexy horned holy horse that just loooves virgins around there, too!

Entry.JapaneseText: 馬のくせに変態なんて、 ちょっとイヤね。 でも見てみたーい！
Entry.EnglishText: But how can a horse be such a perv? Kinda creepy, right? But I still reeeaaaally wanna see one!

Entry.JapaneseText: 世界が滅びる、だって……？ はん、こんな世界、滅びても いいんじゃないかい？
Entry.EnglishText: The world's ending, you say...? Hah. Who even cares if some crappy world like this gets destroyed?

Entry.JapaneseText: 僕には夢も希望も 残されていないんだ、 勝手にすれば？
Entry.EnglishText: I have no hopes or dreams left, anymore. Someone wants to end the world? Hey, go for it.

Entry.JapaneseText: 僕のすべてを全力で 否定するこの世界なんて、 あってもなくても一緒だ
Entry.EnglishText: This world's rejected me at every single turn. I really don't give a damn if it ends or not.

Entry.JapaneseText: もうどうなってもいいさ。 あがいたって、非力な僕に 世界は救えっこないし
Entry.EnglishText: Whatever happens is fine by me. I could struggle and flail, sure, but how would a powerless sap like me save anything?

Entry.JapaneseText: 魔科学に心も体も、 一生を捧げた僕…… だが、もう魔科学はダメだって……
Entry.EnglishText: I've devoted myself to magitech, mind, body, and soul...and all just to be told, "Magitech's banned. Try something else."

Entry.JapaneseText: 一体、僕の一生は 何だったってんだ
Entry.EnglishText: So what's the damn point? That's my whole life, just... Gone. Wasted. Like that.

Entry.JapaneseText: 僕はユークリッドの 研究所で研究員をしてたんだ
Entry.EnglishText: I worked as a researcher at Euclid's research lab.

Entry.JapaneseText: だがスタンリー所長以下、 全員が魔科学から違う形での 大系の模索に転換した
Entry.EnglishText: But everyone—from lab manager Stanley on down—has started searching for some new grand theory, separate from magitech.

Entry.JapaneseText: 魔科学に変わるものなんて、 この世にあるわけないのにさ！
Entry.EnglishText: But there's nothing in this world that can take the place of magitech! Nothing!

Entry.JapaneseText: 僕は魔科学研究者だ。 今も昔も変わることなく、 僕の中にはマナの血が流れる
Entry.EnglishText: I'm a magitech researcher. I am now as I've always been. Mana runs in my very veins.

Entry.JapaneseText: 世界が魔科学を否定しても、 僕は魔科学の研究を続けるよ。 たとえ捕まってもね
Entry.EnglishText: Even if the world rejects magitech, I'll continue my magitech research. I won't stop even if they arrest me.

Entry.JapaneseText: 僕は地下にもぐって 魔科学の研究を続けるつもりさ
Entry.EnglishText: I think I'll burrow my way underground and research magitech down there.

Entry.JapaneseText: 人の世界を救えるのは 魔科学だけなんだ。 偉い人はそれがわかってないんだ！
Entry.EnglishText: Only magitech can save the world. All these people in charge just don't get it!

Entry.JapaneseText: 汚い毒の霧が 晴れますように……
Entry.EnglishText: That this unclean, toxic mist be cleared away...

Entry.JapaneseText: キミたちもやってよ。 この噴水にお金を入れて、 お祈りすると叶うんだよ？
Entry.EnglishText: You should join me. If you throw coins into this fountain and pray, your prayers will be answered!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……むにゃむにゃむにゃ……
Entry.EnglishText: ...*mutter* *mutter*...

Entry.JapaneseText: 早く旅に出た父さんと母さん、 お兄ちゃんが帰ってきますように ってお願いしたのよ
Entry.EnglishText: "I hope my father and mother and brother that are traveling come home soon." That's what I wished for.

Entry.JapaneseText: この噴水はね お金を入れると、水の女神様が お願いを叶えてくれるんだって
Entry.EnglishText: This fountain's special. If you throw money into it, the goddess of water will grant all of your wishes!

Entry.JapaneseText: キミたちも願い事があるなら やってごらんよ？
Entry.EnglishText: You guys must have some wishes. You should give it a try, too!

Entry.JapaneseText: ５０００ガルド入れたら、 小さな幸せが手に入って
Entry.EnglishText: If you throw 5,000 Gald in, you'll be a little luckier.

Entry.JapaneseText: ７０００ガルドで 嫌な人を遠ざけて、
Entry.EnglishText: If you throw 7,000 Gald in, all the weird and scary people will stay away from you.

Entry.JapaneseText: １２０００ガルドだと、 好きな人と結ばれるんだって。 がめつい女神様だよね
Entry.EnglishText: And if you throw 12,000 Gald, you can marry the person you like! This goddess is kinda greedy, huh?

Entry.JapaneseText: この噴水はこの街の 浄水施設の一部として 作られたんだよ～
Entry.EnglishText: This fountain is connected to the town's clean water supply~

Entry.JapaneseText: きれいにされた水がここへ 辿り着くの。人々はここで 生活の水を汲んでいくのよ～
Entry.EnglishText: The water it uses is clean and tasty. A lot of people even drink and cook with it~

Entry.JapaneseText: 最近は水道が整備された家が 多くなったから、この噴水、 使う人、少なくなったね
Entry.EnglishText: Lately, a lot of houses have had indoor plumbing installed, so not as many people use the fountain's water.

Entry.JapaneseText: だからかな、お金ほりこむ人 増えたのって。 ……私が広めてるから……？
Entry.EnglishText: And so, more people trow money into the fountain now. ...Maybe they got the idea from me?
Entry.Notes: intentional misspelling of "throw," don't correct it

Entry.JapaneseText: 君らの持ってくる強さを参考に 最適のトレーニング方を開発する それがヒリップ強まり計画さ
Entry.EnglishText: To ponder the strength you bring before me and develop a perfect training method... That's Phillip's Strength Training Plan.

Entry.JapaneseText: これで条件はクリアされた…… さあ、強まるぞ～
Entry.EnglishText: Okay, now that all the pieces are in play... It's finally time to train~

Entry.JapaneseText: もう帰るって、 おめらやる気あるだか？ まんず町を見て回るだ
Entry.EnglishText: Ya want to go back already? You've got no motivation at all, do ya. Come on, take a look around town, at least.
